answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one jade-sealed work record per epoch, binding its key, epoch, and work hash. A public plume auditor re-executes one sampled prior record each epoch: a record whose output does not reproduce is a fable, and its bond plus unreleased reward burn. Filing starts at 22, rising as 22+4(k-1) for the k-th, so the 1000th fake costs 4,018 and 1,000 fakes cost 2,020,000 in fees plus 70,000 at risk. A rented-record ring fails: a rented jade seal cannot sign the claimant key. An honest identity pays 22 once and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
